description_en: Unbinds key pairs from simple application servers
description_zh: 解绑轻量应用服务器的密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open detach-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-ids 2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc0000 --biz-key-pair-name KeyPairName --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the simple application servers from which you want to unbind SSH key pairs. You can specify a maximum of 50 IDs of simple application servers
parameters.help_zh: 解绑SSH密钥对的实例ID。最多支持50个实例ID
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be globally unique. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter but cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。必须保持名称唯一性。 长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

FailCount.description_en: The total number of simple application servers from which you fail to unbind key pairs
FailCount.description_zh: 绑定密钥对失败的实例总数量

items.description_en: The result set of the unbind operation
items.description_zh: 解绑密钥对成功或失败的结果集合

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the simple application server

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the key pair is unbound from the simple application server successfully. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
密钥对解绑是否成功。可能值：

true：密钥对解绑成功。

false：密钥对解绑失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of simple application servers from which the SSH key pair is unbound
TotalCount.description_zh: 解绑密钥对的实例总数量
